title: Noisy Logs — Single Cause (dc1-spine2 Ethernet3 Down)
symptom: dc1-spine2: syslog storm 1200+ events in 10 min. BGP notifications to dc1-leaf2a repeated. One session down. Optical Rx degraded on Ethernet3.
root_cause: Ethernet3 on dc1-spine2 (uplink to dc1-leaf2a) is shutdown. Single physical fault causing cascading BGP/syslog storm. All other sessions healthy.
